proposed_minimum_API.visibility: Only the existing application exposes public publication. Its completion flag is checked before calling the private runtime method; otherwise the current runtime() accessor could bypass that guard after a late initialization failure. No public free publisher or arbitrary owner parameter is introduced.
proposed_minimum_API.helper_behavior: Original 00530620 calls the existing ordinary typed ignore helper and returns true. Otherwise compare with the genuine raw symbol address; only that exact match gets C3 qualification followed by a direct named raw leaf call and true. Unknown values return false without dereference so both existing callers retain their current rejection diagnostics. Qualification failure throws before publication/call; no default fallback.
proposed_minimum_API.qualification_algorithm: Obtain uintptr_t from the declared raw function symbol under the MSVC Win32 contract; read the single volatile code byte at that trusted linked function address and require 0xC3, otherwise throw logic_error. No caller-controlled address is dereferenced. Qualification is a code read, not an entry call. The executable/readable linked-image and code-lifetime requirement must be established for the actual future build; the current audit makes no loaded-image claim.
proposed_minimum_API.noexcept: The new owner and qualification methods are not noexcept: invalid lifetime/phase/publication/preimage/code state must fail before publication. Existing raw C3 and notifier noexcept declarations/bodies remain unchanged.
proposed_minimum_API.default_and_opt_in: Normal initialize_core continues installing numeric Original identities. Only explicit publish_and_borrow_raw_failure_manager transitions +90 to callable Source mode. The method publishes and returns a borrow but never calls the raw notifier or supplies its arguments.
proposed_minimum_API.code_lifetime: Reuse bsp_core static-library membership and the normal bsp_game dependency. The exact symbol must be linked into the retained executable image; an unloadable callback-module contract is not introduced. Current whole-object membership does not itself prove that future loaded address.

ordered_guard_and_publication_contract: MSVC Win32 only; sizeof(void*) and sizeof(uintptr_t) equal four. Use the address of raw_ignore_native_vfs_mount_failure_00530620, never the ordinary typed ignore helper or a numeric Original identity.

Add application core_initialization_completed=false; set it only at the final successful end of Impl::initialize_core after bind_resource_registry_domain. initialization_attempted and runtime() non-null alone are insufficient. The application method rejects unless completed.

The runtime method rejects before touching owner storage unless core_registered is true and retired is false. Keep existing initialization_attempted/core_started one-attempt behavior; do not retry or allocate another manager.

Caller has exclusive access to this application and publication for the entire publish/borrow-use interval. No concurrent startup, publication replacement, callback mutation or shutdown. The existing model provides no synchronized borrow counter or lease.

Capture the existing volatile Source publication once; reject null or any value unequal to inputs.actual_vfs_storage_a0. This is the real retained A0 allocation. It does not establish Original fixed address0109CEEC.

Read this captured owner’s initialized +90 and +8C words. Require +90 to be either Original 00530620 or the exact qualified Source raw symbol address, and +8C to remain Original 00735B30. Reject all other preimages; no overwrite or fallback.

Before a store, resolve the genuine raw function through its declared symbol and verify its first/complete code byte is C3 in the linked, loaded, readable executable code domain. This exact one-byte entry is in the retained whole object today; qualification of a future linked/loaded image remains required. Never manufacture executable bytes or cast an arbitrary supplied word to code.

After all checks, write only the captured owner’s +90 DWORD with that actual symbol address (volatile Win32 word store) and return only the captured borrowed void*. Do not invoke a callback/notifier, write +8C/+18/global cells, or rerun the two-store installer. Repeating the API with the same qualified pointer is idempotent; no reverse-mode API is proposed.

The returned pointer owns nothing and grants no extra lifetime. Finish every use before GameSingletonHost.shutdown begins; keep application, runtime, host, their referenced data/services and the statically linked code image alive through uses and shared drain. After drain the runtime retired flag rejects new borrows before dereferencing freed owner storage.
